# Byte-preserved private shape data

The Core C0 schema is copied exactly from Nautilus Engine commit 8b4cd72c2d8f424d6811196d9651916bb7e9e2bd. The UI proposal schema is copied exactly from commit 05723c3cada36249c6b6777dd40c8a478701bccb. Original paths and raw SHA-256/byte counts are in source.json. The repository is https://github.com/Syntaxswine/nautilus-engine.

These are immutable schema data, not imported Core/Host/provider implementations, public schemas or authority. All original notices/description fields are preserved. Component adapters remain outside vendor/. No Artist PNG, external font or stock graphic is imported by this UI. Synthetic commands keep original artwork notices as fixture metadata and prove no verified bytes.
